steps.name: R-socraticode-use-0
steps.cmd: C="$SCRATCH_CFG" && echo "mcporter $(mcporter --version)" && mcporter --config "$C" list socraticode --json --no-oauth | python3 -c 'import glob,json,os,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d["transport"];e=[x for x in t.split() if x.endswith("/dist/index.js")][0];v=json.load(open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(e)),"package.json")))["version"];s=[x["version"] for x in json.load(open("manifests/stack.json"))["components"] if x["id"]=="socraticode"];w=sorted({y["pin"] for f in glob.glob("catalogs/landscape/*.json") for l in json.load(open(f)).get("layers",[]) for y in (l.get("winners") or []) if y.get("component_id")=="socraticode"});print("server",d["name"],"status",d["status"]);print("transport",t);print("package.json beside that entry point:",v,"| stack",s,"| winner pins",w);sys.exit(0 if d["status"]=="ok" and v in w else 1)'

steps.name: S6a-daemon-status-check
steps.cmd: mcporter daemon status --json | python3 -c 'import json,os,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);c=open("/proc/%d/cmdline"%d["pid"]).read().replace(chr(0)," ");ok=d["protocolVersion"]==3 and d["socketPath"].startswith(os.environ["MCPORTER_DAEMON_DIR"]) and "/tools/mcporter-0.14.1/" in c and len(d["servers"])>=2 and all(s["connected"] and s["activeCalls"]==0 for s in d["servers"]);print(sorted((s["connectionId"],s["connectionGeneration"]) for s in d["servers"]));sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'
